items.note: Consistent lighting and darkened crevices over all chains. Still-image quality is reviewed; Phase 7 anti-aliasing and presentation refinements remain separate work.

The converged and interactive native images are populated and finite, with no visible cracks, missing faces or conflicting surfaces in the reviewed stills. A still does not certify orbit/trajectory flicker.
Measured colored foreground widths at 768 pixels are native 366, MolStar 362, PyMOL 371. All differences are below 1.4%; measurements are recorded in target/ribbon-quality-verification/framing.json.

The native circular guide trace retains the complete 1AON fold, passes through source guides and shows no visible frame flips. Requested eight-step sampling is proven by the large-source regression. References establish the fold and continuity, not literal cross-engine pixel or profile equality.

scope: The four attached still-image checklist facts pass. Full Phase 3.1 gaps/helix/nucleotide capabilities and temporal presentation quality are not certified by this case.
reference_semantics: MolStar uses a thin guide trace; PyMOL uses its ribbon guide presentation. Their stroke/profile choices differ from the native circular tube, so the reviewed comparison concerns topology, guide continuity, lighting and framing. Native Trace and Tube currently share circular guide geometry; no distinction in stroke semantics is invented by this review.
